sentences.text: The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Sultanganj P.S. Case No.451 of 2022 instituted under Sections 365,364,120(B),302/34,420 of the IPC lodged on 23.11.2022 by the informant Sadanand Jha.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation is of kidnapping and killing of Amit Kumar Jha and the reason is that an agreement was made for the sale of a piece of a land for Rs.72 lacs which was paid by Amit Kumar Jha and was forcing the accused persons for getting the land transferred.
The apprehended accused persons including the petitioner confessed to their guilt.
It is the case of the petitioner that main allegation is against Dilip Mandal, further, confession before police has made Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.52496 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 him suffer.
Learned APP on the other hand submits that a bare perusal of learned Sessions Judge order would show the involvement of all the accused persons including the petitioner have been found.

Taking into account the allegation that has come against the petitioner, for the present, this Court is Himalaya Kumar @ Himalaya @ Sagar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27152814/
1 not inclined to grant him privilege of bail, which is accordingly rejected.
